svg.title: Moog Grandmother connections
svg.desc: Connection inventory. Arrows indicate signal direction relative to the instrument. Locations identify hardware faces; the diagram is not a socket placement drawing. Physical control sections are listed below.
svg.text: Arrows are relative to the device. Locations name the hardware face; sockets are grouped by function.

svg.text: PHYSICAL CONTROLS / see interface.svg for labelled positions
MODULATION PATCH: Rate IN, Wave OUT, S/H OUT
OSC 1 PATCH: Pitch IN, PWM IN, Wave OUT
OSC 2 PATCH: Pitch IN, PWM IN, Wave OUT
MIXER PATCH: Osc IN, Noise IN, OUT
FILTER PATCH: Audio IN, Cutoff IN, OUT
ENVELOPES PATCH: Trigger IN, Env OUT
ARP / SEQ: Rate, Mode, Octave, Hold, Play, Tap, Glide
MODULATION: Rate, Waveform, Pitch amt, Cutoff amt, PWM amt
FILTER: Cutoff, Resonance, Env amt, KB track
